criteria.requirement: Add natsort.search.NaturalSortedIndex(iterable,*,key=None,alg=ns.DEFAULT,reverse=False). Snapshot original record order and precomputed natural keys, reject unordered input without sorting, support rank(value,side), count(value), and between(start,stop,include_start,include_stop) with None for unbounded ranges. Query values are already extracted fields; results preserve original records and input direction. Equal natural keys and reverse indexes need correct binary boundaries. Locale changes invalidate locale indexes; caller rebuilds after record/key-policy mutation. Do not change ordinary natsort.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
